title: Heinrich Weber, Lehrbuch der Algebra: German LaTeX and English Translation Working Drafts
description:
Dedicated Heinrich Weber Lehrbuch der Algebra working-edition record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project.

Status at a glance. Volume I is represented as a repaired/source-scan-audited working edition. Volume II has current German/English cumulative reader PDFs through section 176, with canonical section packages for §§163-176 and a growing set of localized recursive repair packets. Volume III remains the current repaired cumulative from the earlier baseline. These are working drafts and repair ledgers, not final critical editions or mathematically certified editions.

Latest update. Adds Batch126. It integrates local final-ledger inputs and applies four scan-lane microfixes to Volume II §§6, 14, 16, and 17: a §6 footnote patch and three kappa/varkappa symbol patches. It also adjudicates the uploaded Volume II §71 p.277 patch against a 545dpi source scan and makes no TeX replacement because the current cumulative already contains the p.277 block and one uploaded matrix entry diverges from the scan. The active 112-row repair ledger now records 28 closed rows and 84 open rows; Tier-3 remains 11/11 closed.

OCR and display ledgers are omission guards and locator layers, not independent authority. Source scans, page ledgers, and included render checks govern promoted range claims.

Corrections and contributions. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through the GitHub mirror via issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Latest public update adds Weber Batch126: Vol. II §6 footnote patch and Vol. II §§14, 16, 17 kappa/varkappa symbol patches. Ledger status after Batch126: 28/112 closed, 84/112 open, Tier-3 closed 11/11. Working drafts only; source scans and ledgers govern reliability.
